title: On-the-Fly Homographies Calibration for Multi-Camera Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.18582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Precise multi-camera tracking traditionally relies on rigorous 3D site calibration, yet this requirement is often operationally impossible in large-scale deployments. Privacy regulations frequently prohibit recording video for offline calibration; limited bandwidth precludes synchronizing high-resolution streams from hundreds of cameras; and covering immense physical sites with calibration targets is logistically infeasible. We present a multi-camera homography calibration system designed to overcome these barriers through "on-the-fly" geometric refinement. Starting from coarse manual homographies, we introduce a centroid-based projection optimization (PO) that continuously aligns the ground-plane geometry using live detection streams. Because PO operates asynchronously on already-transmitted, lightweight metadata, it adds zero computational latency to the real-time tracker. translated_title: 面向多相机跟踪的即时单应性标定
translated_abstract: 摘要：精确的多相机跟踪传统上依赖于严格的3D场地标定，然而在大规模部署中，这一要求通常在操作上是无法实现的。隐私法规经常禁止录制视频用于离线标定；有限的带宽使得无法同步来自数百个相机的高分辨率视频流；而用标定靶标覆盖巨大的物理场地在后勤上也不可行。我们提出了一种多相机单应性标定系统，旨在通过“即时”几何优化来克服这些障碍。从粗糙的手动单应性出发，我们引入了一种基于质心的投影优化（PO）方法，利用实时检测流持续对齐地面平面几何。由于PO在已传输的轻量级元数据上异步运行，它为实时跟踪器增加了零计算延迟。这使得系统能够自动适应相机的移动……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于质心投影优化的即时单应性标定系统，通过异步处理轻量级检测元数据持续优化地面几何对齐，无需严格的3D场地标定即可实现零额外延迟的多相机跟踪。
en_tdlr: We propose an on-the-fly homography calibration system with centroid-based projection optimization (PO) that continuously refines ground-plane geometry via asynchronous lightweight metadata, enabling zero-latency multi-camera tracking without rigorous 3D site calibration.
